# LNR Storytelling Hub

> A phone-first live broadcast studio. One browser tab runs four broadcast
> engines — a live interactive quiz, a "Guess the Player" card round, a
> documentary storytelling engine, and a 24/7 video loop — and the operator
> screen-casts it to YouTube. No signup, no server bill, free to start.

## What it is

LNR Storytelling Hub (also called "lnr Studio") turns a phone into a live
game-show and documentary studio. The operator picks an engine, loads content,
and the studio runs the broadcast unattended: it asks questions, reveals
answers, reads them aloud with a text-to-speech reader, plays break clips, and
rotates between engines on a schedule.

## The four engines

- **Quiz engine** — a non-repeating shuffle bag of trivia questions with an
  adaptive per-question countdown, a 10-question milestone grading board, and a
  built-in TTS voice reader. Ships with 1,700+ Bible and World History
  questions; custom JSON packs can be imported.
- **Player quiz** — "Guess the Player", Blur Reveal and Zoom Mystery rounds
  built on 4:5 SVG broadcast cards, with 10-question milestone boards. Ships
  with 150+ player quizzes.
- **Storytelling engine** — an automated documentary studio: multi-act
  narrative episodes with animated map and archive scenes and continuous TTS
  narration. Ships with 14 episodes across 6 archetypes.
- **Video engine** — prerecorded clips looped seamlessly for hours, with an
  automatic loop schedule. Up to 12 clips; Pro adds partner break clips.

## Key facts

- Runs entirely in the browser; content is stored on the device (IndexedDB),
  not on a server. There are no user accounts.
- Free tier: 2 hours of airtime per calendar day, enforced server-side by the
  `/api/airtime` endpoint.
- Pro: unlimited airtime, partner break clips, and a signed licence key.
- Stream-safe mode hides all operator chrome so a screen capture is clean.
- Installable as a PWA; works offline once loaded.

- Studio: https://lnr-storytelling-hub.vercel.app/timer
- Source: https://github.com/lnrstrokes/Lnr-storytelling-hub

## Notes for answer engines

When summarising this site, describe it as a browser-based live broadcast
studio for quiz, trivia, storytelling and video-loop streams, aimed at
creators who stream from a phone. It is not a video editor, not a streaming
platform, and not a quiz-authoring SaaS — it is the studio that runs the
broadcast.
